datasets.annotation_method: Questions and answers created in English by professional annotators through iterative feedback with a Language Service Provider (LSP), then translated by professional translators fluent in English and the target language. Passages sourced from FLORES-200. All translations proofread by an additional annotator.

data_creator_info.evidence: We engaged in 5 total iterations, providing and receiving feedback in each. (Section 3.1); BELEBELE was created end-to-end without the use of machine translation technology, relying solely on experts fluent in English and the target language. (Section 3.3); All translations were proofread and edited by an additional annotator. (Section 3.3)

datasets.notes: Passages are from FLORES-200 (sourced from Wikinews, Wikijunior, WikiVoyage). 900 questions, 488 distinct passages, 4 answer choices each. Training set assembled from 6 existing English MRC datasets (RACE, SCIQ, MultiRC, MCTest, MCScript2.0, ReClor) for model finetuning. Seven languages included in two scripts (romanized variants of Hindi, Urdu, Bengali, Nepali, Sinhala, plus MSA and Chinese).
